# Business Description, starting template

`blog-system-install` fills this in during its interview and writes it into the
Drive folder. `keyword-topic-research` reads it to generate topic candidates when
the owner has no idea in mind, so vagueness here produces vague topics.

## The basics

- Business name:
- Location, and the area actually served:
- Niche, in one sentence:
- Years in operation:
- Website:
- Platform (WordPress, Squarespace, Wix, Shopify, custom):

### Key page URLs

*`blog-writer` links to these in every article and is instructed never to guess a
URL, so an incomplete list here means the first few posts have nothing to link to.*

- Services or products:
- About:
- Contact:

## Target customer

*Specific beats flattering. "Couples planning a first wedding on a tight budget"
generates useful topics. "Anyone who values quality" generates nothing.*
